mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO trace_conversation (conversation_id, trace_id, user_id, source, agent_id, agent_name, start_ts, end_ts, duration_ms, status, error_message, event_count, token_input, token_output, model) VALUES
(#{item.conversationId}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.source}, #{item.agentId}, #{item.agentName}, #{item.startTs}, #{item.endTs}, #{item.durationMs}, #{item.status}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.eventCount}, #{item.tokenInput}, #{item.tokenOutput}, #{item.model})

INSERT INTO trace_event (event_id, conversation_id, trace_id, event_type, event_name, source, timestamp, duration_ms, event_json) VALUES
(#{item.event_id}, #{item.conversation_id}, #{item.trace_id}, #{item.event_type}, #{item.event_name}, #{item.source}, #{item.timestamp}, #{item.duration_ms}, #{item.event_json})
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, trace_id, user_id, source, agent_id, agent_name, start_ts, end_ts, duration_ms, status, error_message, event_count, token_input, token_output, model FROM trace_conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY end_ts DESC LIMIT 1
